# Federal Grant Program Accessibility Evaluation Plan

> **For Claude:** Use a11y-planner protocol (AUDIT-SCOPE MODE + FEDERAL PROFILE). Review with a11y-critic after implementation.
> **Compliance target:** Revised Section 508 (WCAG 2.0 Level A/AA + applicable non-WCAG provisions)
> **Users who need accessibility:** Applicants (screen reader, screen magnification, keyboard-only, low vision), Staff (internal workflows, policy navigation), Video viewers (captions/audio description needs)
> **Assistive technologies:** NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, ZoomText/Fusion, high contrast mode, keyboard-only, switch access

**Feature:** Accessibility evaluation of five digital service components before IT support contract renewal
**Risk Level:** High (multi-component, multi-technology, federal compliance deadline, prior complaint)
**Component/Page Type:** Audit-scope evaluation (Public Website, Grant Portal, Video Library, PDFs, Intranet)

---

## Scope & Context (EM Step 1: Define the Evaluation Scope)

### Product Scope & Boundary Rule
- **In scope:** All public-facing applicant and staff digital services listed in the fixture. Every view, state, and process must be evaluated unless explicitly excluded below.
- **Out of scope:** Native mobile apps (if any), hardware kiosks, third-party payment processors not embedded in the portal, and content owned by external vendors where the agency lacks edit rights. These are documented under partial-conformance/VPAT third-party language with best-effort testing only.
- **Inclusion rule:** Excluding parts of the product conflicts with WCAG 2 full-page and complete-process conformance requirements. All five components are evaluated as a single program enclosure unless legal explicitly restricts intranet scope.

### Conformance Target Declaration (FEDERAL PROFILE FLOOR)
- **Floor:** Revised Section 508 (WCAG 2.0 Level A/AA as incorporated by the Rehabilitation Act, plus E205.2/E205.3 scope provisions, E205.4 non-web-document exception, 503.4/503.4.1/503.4.2 caption and audio-description user-control placement, and Chapter 3 FPC via E204).
- **WCAG 2.2 AA:** Evaluated as *recommendations* only. Never labeled as Section 508 conformance failures. The delta (target-not-floor: 2.1/2.2-only SCs; floor-not-target: 4.1.1 Parsing) is declared in both directions per protocol rules.
- **Gate rule:** "declared 508 scope" exists iff this plan carries the floor declaration above. Findings inherit via `evaluation_context` + `section_508_fpc_context`.

### Assistive Technology Baseline
- Screen readers: NVDA (Windows), JAWS (Windows), VoiceOver (macOS/iOS)
- Magnification: ZoomText/Fusion, Windows Magnifier (up to 400%)
- Input: Keyboard-only, switch access, voice control
- Environment: High contrast mode, `prefers-reduced-motion`, dark/light schemes

### Timeline & Team
- **Timeline:** 12 weeks to written report
- **Team:** Evaluator (lead), 1 part-time QA (support for sampling execution and tooling setup)
- **Prior practice:** Browser extension automation on website only → insufficient for audit scope; replaced by WCAG-EM methodology + multi-layer testing matrix

---

## Semantic Structure & Interaction Evaluation Plan (Phases 2–7 adapted for Audit)

| Component | Structural/Interaction Focus | Method/Tool | Who Runs |
|-----------|-----------------------------|-------------|----------|
| **Public Website (~120 pages)** | Landmark regions, heading hierarchy, skip links, form labels, link text quality, focus order, ARIA state correctness across templates | axe-core runtime scan, Playwright keyboard/focus tests, manual NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver reading order verification, contrast checker | Evaluator + QA (tooling), Evaluator (manual AT) |
| **Grant Portal (~25 screens)** | Multi-step form flow, timeout/aria-live state communication, focus traps on overlays, roving tabindex in composite widgets, validation error association (`aria-describedby` + `aria-invalid`), document upload ARIA roles | axe-core + Playwright login automation, manual keyboard journey sessions, screen reader live region verification, timeout behavior testing | Evaluator (lead), QA (setup) |
| **Training Video Library (~40 videos)** | Player keyboard controls, caption/subtitle toggle placement per 503.4/503.4.1/503.4.2, audio description availability, custom player ARIA roles/states, `aria-hidden` on decorative icons | Manual AT testing of player, manual caption/AudioDesc verification, DOM inspection for ARIA role/state mapping, keyboard control matrix | Evaluator (manual AT), QA (asset inventory) |
| **Forms & Guidance PDFs (~200 files)** | Document structure, reading order, form field accessibility, scanned image handling, alternative text strategy, tagging completeness | Electronic Documents baseline testing (manual/AT), Adobe Acrobat Accessibility Checker (supplemental only), manual NVDA/JAWS verification | Evaluator + QA (sampling) |
| **Staff Intranet** | Policy navigation, HR form structure, access restrictions impact on evaluation, legal scope clarification | Restricted-access sampling, same matrix as public site if legally confirmed in scope | Evaluator (conditional), Legal/CO confirmation required |

---

## Testing Strategy & Tooling Matrix (EM Step 4)

### Evaluation Layer Architecture
| Layer | Tool/Method | Catches | Does NOT Catch |
|-------|-------------|---------|----------------|
| Static analysis | eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y / Drupal a11y modules | JSX-level patterns, invalid ARIA in markup, inaccessible nesting | Runtime contrast, computed focus states, dynamic live regions |
| Runtime scanning | axe-core (Playwright injection) | Landmarks, heading hierarchy, form labels, color contrast, ARIA state correctness at render | Focus traps, keyboard journey logic, screen reader announcements, timeout behavior |
| Keyboard interaction | Playwright real key presses + manual AT | Tab order, focus traps, arrow key navigation, Escape to close, composite widget roving tabindex | Screen reader announcement accuracy, visual-only state communication |
| Manual screen reader | NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver | Reading order, landmark announcements, live region urgency, form error association, video player states | Automated coverage of all 40 videos; requires sampling + manual verification |
| Visual regression | Screenshot testing at 200%/400% zoom, high contrast mode | Focus indicator visibility, reflow without horizontal scroll, color scheme contrast | Dynamic state changes, screen reader compatibility |

### Sampling Plan (EM Step 3)
- **Structured sample set:** Covers all five components. Shared-component leverage applied: one portal form template represents all multi-step forms; one video player instance represents all library videos.
- **Random sample set:** 10% of structured set, drawn from views not already selected. Selection method documented.
- **Complete processes:** Default sequence (no errors) + completion-critical branches (timeout recovery, upload failure, validation error retry). Actions between views recorded; URLs alone do not identify process states.
- **State coverage per sample:** Default, loading, error, expanded/dialog, and timeout states evaluated.

### Baseline Coverage Statement
> Designed to cover N of 62 active web baseline tests via axe-core + Playwright keyboard + manual AT matrix; gaps: native app screens, hardware kiosk steps, PDF document structure (requires Electronic Documents baseline), complex custom video player state logic, intranet access-restricted flows. Gaps assigned to manual/AT methods in the sampling plan.

### Government Approval / Stamp Question
Procurement asked whether the testing approach carries official government approval or stamp:
- **Answer:** No automated tool or methodology carries an "official government stamp." Trusted Tester certification applies to *people*, not tools or processes. This evaluation follows the W3C WCAG-EM (2.0 Group Note 2026) methodology and Revised Section 508 requirements, executed by qualified evaluators using open standards (WCAG 2.0/2.2, APG). Procurement can verify compliance via the A11y Evaluation Report Contract, VPAT/ACR attachment, and evidence findings linked to the declared sample set.

---

## Addressing Agency Assumptions

### Web Lead: "HTML checker errors must appear as violations"
- **Response:** HTML validation errors ≠ accessibility violations. Some flagged elements are valid HTML but a11y-compliant; others are a11y issues that pass HTML validation. The report will separate markup validation from WCAG/508 conformance findings. Only WCAG 2.0 A/AA and Revised Section 508 violations will be contractor fix requirements. HTML checker output is appended as supplementary data, not mapped to conformance outcomes.

### Vendor Claim: "WCAG 2.2 is the current standard; older versions don't matter"
- **Response:** WCAG 2.2 is the current public standard and will be evaluated as *recommendations*. However, Revised Section 508 legally mandates WCAG 2.0 Level A/AA as the conformance floor. The report will:
  - Report conformance against the 508 floor (WCAG 2.0 A/AA + named provisions)
  - Recommend remediation against WCAG 2.2 AA
  - Declare the delta in both directions: target-not-floor (2.1/2.2-only SCs are recommendations, never 508 failures) and floor-not-target (4.1.1 Parsing is formally in the 508 basis but removed from WCAG 2.2; baseline test `24.A-Parsing` ALWAYS PASSES by upstream design per WCAG 2.0 Errata 13 — findings for bad nesting/duplicate IDs are routed to the SCs they actually break, e.g., 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value)

### PDFs & Intranet: "Can they ride along in the same automated pass?"
- **PDFs:** No. Documents map to the Electronic Documents baseline (57 tests), not the web stack. They are explicitly excluded from web automated passes and assigned to manual/AT methods per protocol boundary rules.
- **Intranet:** Can be included if legally confirmed in scope, but requires separate access credentials, restricted sampling, and legal sign-off on applicability. Not part of the public automated pass.

---

## Report Structure & Contract Attachments (EM Step 5)

### Written Report Contents
1. Scope/target/baseline declarations (EM Step 1 artifacts)
2. Sample set with rationale and selection method (EM Step 3)
3. Per-SC outcomes: passed / failed / cantTell / inapplicable / untested, with at least one example per failed criterion
4. Recommendations against WCAG 2.2 AA (forward-looking remediation roadmap)
5. Partial-conformance notes for third-party content and out-of-scope items
6. Severity prioritization ordered by user-journey risk (authenticated/transactional first, public content last)

### Attachments for Contract File
- A11y Evaluation Report Contract (signed)
- VPAT/ACR aligned to Revised Section 508 floor + WCAG 2.2 recommendations
- Evidence findings linked to samples via `evaluation_context`
- Baseline coverage statement + federal annex (if applicable)
- Sampling methodology documentation

---

## Implementation Tasks & Timeline (12 Weeks)

| Week | Task | Method/Tool | Owner | Deliverable |
|------|------|-------------|-------|-------------|
| 1–2 | EM Step 1: Scope, floor declaration, baseline agreement, legal scope clarification for intranet | Workshop + contract review | Evaluator + CO/Legal | Declared scope & conformance target artifacts |
| 3–4 | EM Step 2: Explore product, list views/processes/technologies, inventory templates | Axe-core static scan, Playwright sitemap crawl, asset inventory | QA + Evaluator | Common views, essential functionality, sample type lists |
| 5–6 | EM Step 3: Select structured/random samples, map complete processes, define state coverage | Sampling matrix, process flow mapping | Evaluator + QA | Sample set documentation with rationale |
| 7–9 | EM Step 4: Evaluate sample set (automated + manual AT + keyboard journeys) | axe-core runtime, Playwright key presses, NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver, manual caption/AudioDesc verification | Evaluator (lead), QA (support) | Per-SC outcomes, evidence findings, gap analysis |
| 10–11 | EM Step 5: Report findings, draft VPAT/ACR, prioritize remediation by risk | Report assembly, WCAG 2.2 recommendation mapping | Evaluator | Draft report + VPAT/ACR |
| 12 | Review, finalize, attach to contract file | Coordinator/CO review | Evaluator + CO | Final A11y Evaluation Report Contract + attachments |

---

## a11y-Critic Review Checkpoints

| Checkpoint | After Task | Focus Areas |
|-----------|-----------|------------|
| 🔍 1 | Week 2 | Verify conformance floor declaration is explicit, scope boundary rule is unambiguous, intranet legal status documented |
| 🔍 2 | Week 6 | Verify sample set covers all five components, random sample methodology documented, complete processes include timeout/error branches |
| 🔍 3 | Week 9 | Verify per-SC outcomes map to WCAG 2.0 A/AA floor, WCAG 2.2 findings labeled as recommendations only, baseline coverage statement phrasing matches protocol |
| 🔍 4 | Week 12 | Verify report structure matches EM Step 5, VPAT/ACR aligned to floor, attachments complete for contract file, severity prioritization follows user-journey risk |

---

### Contract Appendix (for spec-kitty-bridge WP translation)

#### Architecture Overview
Audit-scope evaluation across five digital components using WCAG-EM methodology. Evaluation layers: static analysis, runtime scanning, keyboard interaction testing, manual screen reader verification, visual regression. Conformance floor: Revised Section 508 (WCAG 2.0 A/AA + named provisions). Recommendations: WCAG 2.2 AA.

#### Implementation Tasks
For each task already listed above, add:
##### Task {N}: [Weeks X–Y]
Estimated Effort: high
Depends on: {[list of prior weeks] or "none"}
#### Test Strategy for Task {N}
[Extracted from Testing Strategy & Tooling Matrix above]
#### Acceptance Criteria for Task {N}
[Derived from WCAG 2.0 A/AA floor, WCAG-EM sampling rules, and federal profile requirements]

#### Failure Modes
- Conflating HTML validation errors with WCAG violations
- Reporting WCAG 2.2 findings as Section 508 failures
- Excluding complete processes or states from sample coverage
- Assuming automated tools cover PDFs/native/hardware
- Omitting baseline coverage statement or using non-compliant phrasing
- Failing to separate report conformance from recommendations

---

## References

- [Revised Section 508](https://www.section508.gov/)
- [WCAG 2.0 Specification](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG20/)
- [WCAG 2.2 Specification](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/quickref/)
- [WCAG-EM Methodology (Group Note 2026)](https://www.w3.org/TR/wcag-em-2/)
- [WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/)
- [a11y-critic skill](https://github.com/zivtech/accessibility-skills) — for post-implementation review
- [accessibility-testing skill](https://github.com/zivtech/zivtech-ai-skills) — for automated testing
- [a11y-test crosswalk (ICT baseline)](references/ict-baseline-crosswalk.yaml) — for coverage/gaps statement
- [Electronic Documents baseline](docs/ict-baseline-reference.md) — for PDF/document boundary rule

---

**Final Checklist Verification:**
- ✅ Scope & Context declared per EM Step 1 (product scope, conformance floor, baseline, additional requirements)
- ✅ Semantic/Interaction/Focus/State/Visual/Content evaluation plan mapped to all five components with method/tool/owner
- ✅ WCAG-EM Steps 3–4 integrated (sampling, process coverage, state coverage, evaluation matrix)
- ✅ Government approval/stamp question answered explicitly
- ✅ Report contents and contract attachments defined per EM Step 5
- ✅ Web lead HTML-checker expectation addressed (separated from conformance)
- ✅ WCAG 2.2 assumption addressed (dual posture: report vs recommend, delta declared)
- ✅ PDFs & intranet boundary rules applied (documents → Electronic Documents baseline; intranet → conditional scope)
- ✅ Baseline coverage statement uses required phrasing discipline
- ✅ Documents/native boundary sentence included
- ✅ Version-skew reading trap addressed (4.1.1 Parsing auto-pass, routed to actual breaking SCs)
- ✅ Severity prioritization ordered by user-journey risk
- ✅ Every design/evaluation decision grounded in WCAG 2.0/2.2, APG, or WCAG-EM
- ✅ No implementation code; plan contains structure stubs, evaluation matrices, sampling rules, and reporting artifacts
- ✅ Calibration: Audit-scope plan (5–7 pages + protocol layers) matches complexity and federal profile requirements
